avatarProcedureMember.propertySettlementRule: NEW generated parent is one rank9 ongoing source with individually addressable body expressions. A legal single-effect dispel aimed at one body ends that body only; targeting the perceptible parent casting anchor ends every remaining body. Single-body spells have the same body/parent ending. NEW parent locus is caster's fixed formation point, with a faint visible rune that reveals no hidden spell/owner metadata; a perceived body is also a legal expression target. Real Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3, Action3RP/range60/recharge2, INT+PB vs19, not a rank5 substitute. Capture legality/suppression before removal. Counterspell is cast-time only. At actual ending, intrinsic anatomy/gear vanishes; real property retains its recorded actual world position when the generated body ends; apply actual support and Falling without relocation. No new nearest-space teleport or generic terminal Pending-placement privilege is selected. Existing source-qualified Pending records remain unchanged. If a necessary physical support/placement fact is unavailable, retain the entire affected branch as a physical hold with property conserved; do not fabricate an empty square or an obstruction. Real riders/cargo never teleport/vanish with a generated body. Unsupported real bodies/items follow actual support/Falling; keep custody, mass, Load, claims and clocks. No terminal transport/return, resurrection, harvesting or manufactured loot is granted. Existing Transport6 terminal settlements are used only for their own exact sources. Carried property retains its actual recorded attachment offset during carrier movement; a separate relocation requires its own legal action.

requirementsAssessment.controllerSpellAcquisitionAndPreparation: Bound in W17C authored profile and current Wizard class source, within a conditional test fixture.
requirementsAssessment.paidCreationAndBodyInstantiation: Bound in Return285 events 3 and 5 and closure350 preserved source fork.

conclusion: Return285/Closure350 supplies a bounded conditional source foundation for the Avatar controller, paid finite body, profile, intrinsic armament, zero cargo, command, phase, bludgeoning attack and passive fire-aura dealer. The equipment assessment is now source-complete for this preserved fork. It still does not meet DF218-B02: no native elemental attack, no lawful Shell caster/application, no Shell bearer or incoming Shell root, no reflection, and no integrated terminal Shell settlement. The Avatar acceptance is identity-specific and all recipients remain synthetic conditional fixtures.
